proof_explanation: The negate function is implemented as Bool.not(value), which directly satisfies the law negate_matches_boolean_not. The proof is syntactically trivial since negate(value) is definitionally equal to Bool.not(value), making the equality reflexive. The {==} proof combinator confirms this reflexive equality.
